location_description:
Fox Chapel is a borough in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania, USA, and is an affluent suburb of Pittsburgh located 6 miles (10 km) northeast of downtown. The borough continually garners national prominence and is home to many of the wealthiest and most powerful patriciate families in Pennsylvania.The population was 5,388 as of the 2010 census.


== History ==
In the 1750s, the Seneca Indians lived in the region.
